title: Kundalini's Coil & Print
description: A mystical scene inside a shop where a woman in a red headscarf and black robe holds a glowing green orb. A large teal and green dragon with red accents coils through the room, its body forming a loop near a large red circular sign covered in colorful paw prints. The shop features shelves with potions, a table with printed dragon designs, and a starry night sky above.
prompt: A mystical woman wearing a red headscarf and black robe stands inside a fantasy shop at night, holding a glowing green orb. A large teal dragon with red spines coils through the blue room, its body arching toward the ceiling. A large red circular sign covered in colorful paw prints hangs on the wall. Shelves display potions and jars, a table shows printed designs with dragons and serpents, candles and scales sit on a counter, under a swirling starry night sky.
